changes: queries: 12 frames per video with the pipeline tiles (whole frame plus three square crops at detail "standard"); every tile row votes on its own (tilePooling "rows"), chosen on the train half among whole / frame / rows (train objective 0.373 / 0.343 / 0.403)

radius: calibrated per evidence tier on the train half to cover the truth in 70 % of its cases: strong (gap >= strongGap and frame agreement >= agreementMin, both chosen on train), other recognition, similarity, country and continent (factor on their radius); frame agreement is a new confidence feature

previous measurement (6 frames, whole frames only, same gallery), test half: open median 233 km, <=1 km 40 %, <=25 km 47 %, <=2500 km 80 %, within radius 43 %; unknown median 751 km, <=25 km 17 %, <=2500 km 70 %, within radius 17 %; train objective 0.377 (now 0.403); the accuracy gain on train did not carry over to the test half
gallery unchanged (6 393 pictures): a broad worldwide layer to 17 945 pictures (fetchDataset.ts --extend) lowered the train objective from 0.403 to 0.283 and was not kept
evaluation uses the live node vector cache (.cache/datum), caches frame vectors, one gallery search serves both modes

protocol.frameSampling: middle of equal segments; tiles as the pipeline at detail "standard" (tile 0 = whole frame, further tiles = square crops), each resized to the model input

modes.open: whole gallery, including the picture of the same Wikidata item (known-landmark case, leakage on purpose)
modes.unknown: gallery without the same Wikidata item (excludeWikidata: [video.wikidata])

protocol.scored: visual estimate (GPS in the file is reported separately and not scored)
protocol.split: manifest videos sorted by id; even index = train (all tuning), odd index = test (report only)
protocol.tuningObjective: mean of the five Im2GPS accuracies, averaged over both modes, train half only

worldModel.model: GeoCLIP (Xenova/geoclip-large-patch14, MIT), int8 image tower unless DATUM_GEOCLIP_PRECISION=fp32, in its worker thread (datum/geoclipService.ts)
worldModel.caveat: the reference landmarks are likely in GeoCLIP's Flickr training data: the gain on landmark videos may be larger than on arbitrary footage

concentrated.rule: radius whose train coverage lies nearer 0.7; 25 km on a tie or with fewer than 4 cases

timing.note: predictFromEmbeddings = scoring against the 100 000 gallery points, modes, refinement and countries in the worker; embedding of the 12 frames comes on top in the node (embedMsPerFrame, from this run or the evaluateGeoclip cache)

timing.embedThroughputNote: gallery thumbnails (~330 px), batch 8, 4 threads; machine shared with other jobs while measured
timing.note: framesMs = sampling and embedding of all tiles (taken from the evaluation cache when present); the live engine reuses the stored tile vectors, so it pays only search and decision

radius.meaning: stated radius per evidence tier, calibrated on the train half to cover the truth in 70 % of its cases (both modes)

calibration.meaning: confidence = estimated probability that the true place lies within radiusKm
